                error_messages.add(message)

print()

print("Departments with >2 employees:")
for dept in sorted(dept_count.keys()):
    if dept_count[dept] > 2:
        print(f"  {dept} ({dept_count[dept]} employees)")

print()

total = sum(float(emp['salary']) for emp in employees)
print(f"Total Budget: ${int(total):,}")
